title: LAHM : Large Annotated Dataset for Multi-Domain and Multilingual Hate Speech Identification
findings: Models fine-tuned on an aggregated English dataset (HSMerge) demonstrated high performance in identifying 'religious hate' speech, achieving an F1-score of 0.92 for translated text and 0.93 in a zero-shot cross-lingual setting. The distribution of predicted religious hate speech varied across languages, with the 'religious hate' category having the lowest overall prediction counts in both the cross-lingual and machine-translation-based experiments.
